title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
synopsis: When Peter asks Doctor Strange to conceal his identity, strangers from other worlds land in his. Sending them back may cost them their lives.
verdictRationale: May sees a frightened man at the shelter where Peter sees another problem to return to Strange. Peter’s willingness to help people who could hurt him gives the story its spiritual weight.
ageRationale: The apartment fight ends with Peter trying to help a dying loved one. Children accustomed to lighter Spider-Man stories may find his bloodied hands and grief especially upsetting.
reflection: May’s work at the shelter gives Peter a place to learn mercy before he needs it in a fight. A family might ask whose need they have walked past because helping would interrupt their day.

title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
synopsis: Cassie’s experiment draws three generations into the Quantum Realm, where Janet knows the people and their ruler far better than she has admitted.
verdictRationale: Scott’s concern for his daughter is persuasive when Kang threatens her. The same family barely considers how Janet’s long deception affected Cassie’s ability to recognize danger. Both choices deserve a hearing after the adventure.
ageRationale: Kang tortures Cassie in front of her father. Rebels disappear under weapons fire, and a sustained fistfight leaves a man bloodied.
reflection: Janet has survived things her family cannot imagine. Truthfulness need not require retelling every wound. She could have warned Cassie that real people lived there and that contacting them could put them at risk.

title: The Marvels
synopsis: Carol, Monica and Kamala unexpectedly trade places when they use their powers. Their search for the cause leads them to Dar-Benn and a world suffering in the aftermath of Carol’s earlier victory.
verdictRationale: Kamala knows Carol as a hero. Monica remembers the adult who left and stayed away. The film gives both women room to speak and asks Carol to take responsibility for harm she never intended.
ageRationale: The heroes evacuate refugees as buildings collapse and breathable air disappears. Some families are left behind. The scene can be distressing even for children comfortable with superhero combat.
reflection: A good intention cannot breathe for the people of Hala. Carol’s story invites a Christian examination of conscience that begins by listening to the people who experienced the consequences.
